passages.p1: Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C or D on your answer sheet to indicate the option that best fits each of the numbered blanks from 1 to 5. The Middle East has long been a region where political interests, security concerns, and historical tensions intersect. Among the most widely discussed rivalries in recent years are those involving the United States, Israel, and Iran. These countries view regional stability through different strategic perspectives. (1) ____________, tensions between these countries increased, and regional security became more fragile. Iran’s nuclear programme has remained one of the most controversial issues in international politics. The United States and Israel have repeatedly expressed concern that Iran could develop nuclear weapons capable of altering the balance of power in the Middle East. Iran, however, maintains that its nuclear activities are intended for peaceful purposes such as energy production and scientific research, a claim (2) ____________. (3) ____________. Instead of large-scale battles between national armies, tensions have often appeared in indirect forms such as economic sanctions, cyber operations, and military activities carried out by allied groups across the region. Although tensions periodically increase, many international organizations and diplomatic actors continue to work toward peaceful solutions. Their efforts focus on promoting dialogue, building trust, and (4) ____________ among nations. Today, (5) ____________. Despite these ongoing tensions, analysts continue to examine the political, economic, and historical factors that influence relations among these countries.

passages.p3: Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the best answer to each of the following questions from 12 to 19. The Strait of Hormuz is one of the most strategically important waterways in the world. Located between Iran and Oman, this narrow passage connects the Persian Gulf to the Gulf of Oman and the Arabian Sea. A significant portion of the world’s oil supply passes through this route every day, making it essential for global energy markets and international trade. Because of its economic importance, the strait has often been at the center of geopolitical tensions. Countries that depend heavily on oil shipments carefully monitor the security of this area. Any disruption to shipping activities in the strait could influence oil prices and affect economies worldwide. For this reason, many nations consider the stability of the region extremely important. The narrow geography of the Strait of Hormuz also contributes to its strategic significance. At its narrowest point, the waterway is only a few dozen kilometers wide. Large oil tankers must pass through designated shipping lanes to avoid accidents and ensure safe navigation. These routes are closely monitored by international maritime authorities. To better understand global energy security, it is helpful to learn about important transportation routes like the Strait of Hormuz. Studying such locations allows people to see how geography, economics, and politics are closely connected in the modern world.
passages.p4: Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the questions from 20 to 29. [I] Recently, a widely circulated online story involving two figures referred to as Khầy and Tym sparked intense debate on social media. While many discussions focused on the personal aspects of the story, others began examining it from a psychological perspective. [II] Some observers suggested that the situation illustrated a pattern commonly described by psychologists as gaslighting. [III] Gaslighting refers to a form of psychological manipulation in which one individual gradually causes another to doubt their own perception of reality, memory, or judgment. [IV] The term originates from a twentieth-century stage play and its later film adaptation, in which a husband manipulates small aspects of the household environment while repeatedly insisting to his wife that nothing has changed. Over time, the wife becomes increasingly uncertain about her own observations and eventually begins to question her sanity. Psychologists later adopted the term gaslighting to describe similar dynamics in interpersonal relationships. In contemporary psychology, gaslighting is not typically associated with overt aggression. Instead, it often unfolds through a sequence of subtle conversational strategies. A manipulator may deny earlier statements, reinterpret events in ways that shift responsibility, or imply that the other person’s emotional reactions are exaggerated or irrational. This pattern, repeated over time, can gradually erode the victim’s confidence in their own interpretations of events. Researchers note that the effectiveness of gaslighting partly lies in its cumulative nature. Individual incidents may appear trivial when viewed in isolation; however, their repeated occurrence creates a broader framework in which the victim increasingly relies on the manipulator’s explanations. As this dependence intensifies, the victim may begin to interpret ambiguous situations through the manipulator’s perspective rather than their own. Understanding such psychological dynamics is important not only for academic research but also for everyday social awareness. Public discussions, even those originating from viral online stories, sometimes bring attention to complex psychological concepts. When examined critically, these discussions can encourage individuals to recognize patterns of manipulation and maintain greater autonomy in their relationships.

passages.p6: Read the following announcement and mark the letter A, B, C or D on your answer sheet to indicate the option that best fits each of the numbered blanks from 35 to 40. You are warmly invited to celebrate the wedding of Van Cuong and Thi Hoa. The ceremony will take place at the Rose Garden Hall, a beautiful venue (35) ____________ overlooks the city lake and provides an elegant atmosphere for this special occasion. Guests are kindly requested to arrive at least thirty minutes early, (36) ____________ everyone enough time to be seated before the ceremony begins. After the wedding vows, a reception dinner will be held in the main hall, where family and friends can share joyful moments together. Please remember to (37) ____________ your invitation card at the entrance so the reception staff can guide you to your table. Formal or semi-formal attire is recommended to match the style of the celebration. In addition, guests are welcome to bring a small gift or a congratulatory card. A decorated box will be placed near the stage as a (38) ____________ place for guests to leave their wishes for the couple. If you have already attended (39) ____________ weddings recently, you will still find this event unique and memorable. The celebration will bring together relatives, friends, and (40) ____________ from different parts of the city to share happiness with the newly married couple.
